title: They don’t stick to anything
text: They don’t stick to anything. These hooks can’t hold any weight. I have a scarf hanging on each hook and they’ve all fallen down multiple times within the first hour I installed them. Terrible quality I would not recommend purchasing these.

product_metadata.title: HUAHUA LALA Adhesive Hooks Heavy Duty Wall Hooks Creative Multi Function Waterproof Hooks for Hanging Coat,Paper Towel,Hook Rack Wall Mount, Large Plastic Hooks- Bathroom,Kitchen and Bedroom 8-Packs…
features: 🎅【Wide Application Organizer】 Simple design, multifunctional. Strong self-adhesive hooks can be mounted vertically, horizontally or under cabinets for coats, towels, cups, kitchen utensils, almost anything. They also ideal for Christmas Lights and Christmas wreath, or other Festival hanging hook.

🎄【Better Design】The hook has no sharp corners and is safer. You will not get hurt by accidentally hitting the hook, especially children.Use these hangers separately as wall hooks, drying racks, door handles,paper towel or 2 or 3 in combination as needed to secure pans, pot lids, cutting boards, plates, oil-absorbing cooking papers, plastic wraps and other kitchen gadgets as needed.

🎅【Wide Application】Widely used on a variety of surfaces, like Wood, Tile, Ceramic ,Metal, Plastic Surface and more (It is not recommended to use this hook on lime walls, plaster walls, rough surfaces on dry walls, and textured wallpaper.), especially great for hanging shower or bath accessories in a bathroom or kitchen utensils and tools on a tile backsplash.
